name: Clarisse D.
title: Feels couture
body: The drape is beautiful and the colour exactly as pictured. I wore it to a wedding and got stopped twice.

name: Ana L.
title: Gorgeous, size up
body: Beautiful satin, true to the photo. I would size up — the fit is on the slimmer side.

name: Julia M.
title: My new staple
body: Fully lined, no cling, and the side slit walks beautifully. Packed with care.

name: Ingrid V.
title: Perfect summer dress
body: Linen is high quality with a soft hand. The wrap tie keeps everything in place.

name: Marta P.
title: Lovely and breathable
body: Great for warm days. A touch long on me (172cm) but easy to take up.

name: Sofia M.
title: Unreal velvet
body: Deep pile, heavy and luxurious. The bias cut is very flattering. Worth every euro.

name: Elena K.
title: Best dress in my closet
body: The straps adjust perfectly and it falls at the ideal midi length on me.

name: Beatriz C.
title: Elegant and packable
body: Rolls flat in a suitcase and comes out ready to wear. Slightly sheer in direct sun.

name: Clarisse D.
title: Lasts months
body: Clean cuticles, zero shedding by week six. Already reordering in a second colour.

name: Nadia B.
title: Exactly single drawn
body: Root to tip thickness is consistent. The colour charts were accurate.

name: Amaia S.
title: Soft wave, soft feel
body: Beautiful blend with my natural texture. Sheds a little at first wash, normal for Remy.

name: Sofia M.
title: The wave is gorgeous
body: Uniform curls, full body, and it holds moisture well. My stylist asked where it was from.

name: Amaia S.
title: A trophy bag
body: Structured, roomy, gorgeous leather smell. Fits my laptop and then some.

name: Mariana R.
title: So elegant
body: The print is unmistakably Belioras. Use it in my hair constantly.

name: Elena K.
title: Weighty and lovely
body: Cinch the waist of any dress instantly. Clasp is solid; wish it came in a shorter option.

name: Ingrid V.
title: Everyday gold
body: Featherlight, comfortable for 10-hour days. Colours have not tarnished.
